messages.text: ERCOT deployed Non-Spin at 100% of awards from 19:27 to 20:26.

messages.content: I’ll charge during the low-priced solar hours, discharge into the evening peak, and earn reserve revenue where the battery can support it without material PV curtailment. I’ll keep some cushion on the longer-duration awards and reassess at each watch.

RegDn charged less than forecast overnight, leaving SoC at 178.1 MWh. The frozen noon reserve hour has a shortfall I can’t fully correct now; I’ll replenish from the first open hour to protect the remaining awards and evening discharge.

ERCOT has deployed Non-Spin for 19:27–20:26. We have no Non-Spin awards in those hours, so the call does not drain our battery. The peak discharge remains frozen; I’ll protect the late-hour reserve obligations in the remaining open hours.
